All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
DynamicCamera
A PhotonVision camera that spots AprilTags and works out where the robot is on the field.
FSMSubsystemBase<S extends Enum<S>>
A subsystem that is always in one of a fixed list of states, like NEUTRAL, INTAKE or SHOOT, and only moves between them along the transitions you allow.
LinearMechanism
Moves in a straight line to a position and holds it, at any incline: sliders (0 degrees), elevators (90 degrees), or anything in between.
LinearSimModel
Something that moves in a straight line between hard stops, at any incline: a slider (0 degrees), an elevator (90 degrees), or anything in between.
Log
Prints messages to the console in one format, [Severity] [Category] message, so they're easy to scan and search.
Log.Type
Areas of the code whose debug messages can be turned on separately.
MechanismBase
What every mechanism has in common: one or more motors, driven to a setpoint, with logging, Shuffleboard tuning widgets and a safety timeout.
MotorControllerConstants
Numbers the motor classes share: encoder resolutions, how often motor controllers report over CAN, and default current limits.
MotorSimModel
Physics for whatever a motor is driving, used only in simulation.
NAR_ButtonBoard
Team 3128's operator button board: 12 buttons and a joystick, read as 16 buttons you can bind commands to.
NAR_CANSpark
A REV Spark MAX or Spark Flex motor controller, which drives NEO, NEO 550 and NEO Vortex motors, using REVLib.
NAR_CANSpark.ControllerType
Which Spark it is.
NAR_CANSpark.EncoderType
Which encoder the Spark reads.
NAR_CANSpark.NAR_SparkMaxConfig
How often each of the Spark's status frames is sent, in milliseconds: 0: output and faults 1: velocity, current, temperature and voltage 2: position 3: an analog sensor 4: an alternate encoder 5 and 6: an absolute encoder's position and velocity Frame 1 is never turned off, since every mechanism logs its motors' current and temperature.
NAR_Joystick
A flight-style joystick, like a Logitech Extreme 3D Pro or Thrustmaster T16000M.
NAR_Motor
One motor and its motor controller, whatever the brand.
NAR_Motor.Control
What NAR_Motor.set(double, Control)'s value means.
NAR_Motor.MotorConfig
The hardware settings for a motor: what units it measures in, how much current it may draw, which way is forward, and whether it brakes when stopped.
NAR_Motor.Neutral
What a motor does when told to stop.
NAR_Motor.StatusFrames
How often a motor controller reports over CAN.
NAR_Robot
The base for Team 3128's Robot class.
NAR_Shuffleboard
Makes Shuffleboard widgets with one line each, and keeps them up to date.
NAR_SysIdCommand
Runs WPILib's SysId tests on a mechanism and records the results, so the SysId tool can work out its feedforward gains (kS, kV, kA, kG) for you.
NAR_TalonFX
A CTRE TalonFX motor controller, which drives Kraken X60, Kraken X44 and Falcon 500 motors, using Phoenix 6.
NAR_XboxController
An Xbox controller, with a few things WPILib's XboxController doesn't do: Sticks have a small deadband, so a stick that doesn't quite center reads 0. Up on either stick is positive.
NAR_XboxController.XboxButton
Every button, plus the two triggers, which count as pressed once squeezed halfway.
NarwhalDashboard
The server for NarwhalDashboard, Team 3128's own web dashboard.
NarwhalDashboard.State
How a part of the robot is doing, shown as a colored light on the dashboard.
PIDFFConfig
The gains (tuning numbers) for a mechanism's control loop: PID plus feedforward.
PivotMechanism
Rotates to an angle and holds it: arms, wrists, shooter hoods, turrets.
PivotMechanism.Orientation
Which way the mechanism points at 0, and so the axis it rotates about.
PivotSimModel
Something that rotates to an angle between hard stops: an arm, wrist, hood, or turret.
RollerMechanism
Something that spins: intakes, hoppers, kickers, shooter flywheels.
RollerMechanism.VelocityControl
How a velocity-controlled roller works out its output.
RollerSimModel
Something that just spins: a roller, flywheel, or kicker.
Tester
Runs system checks in the pits: quick tests that each part of the robot works before a match.
Tester.SystemsTest
One check: runs a command, and passes if it finishes without being interrupted and its pass condition is true at the end.
Tester.Test
A named group of checks for one part of the robot, run one after another.
Tester.TestState
Where a test is up to.
Transition<T extends Enum<T>>
One allowed move in a state machine: from one state to another, and the command that does it.
TransitionMap<S extends Enum<S>>
Every allowed move between the states of an FSMSubsystemBase, and the command each one runs.
